title: CBC Theatre 10:30
identity_notes: CBC dramatic anthology preserved in thirteen frozen recordings. Chronology is disputed: the preservation catalog treats the collection as 1961-era and one file is dated 1961-08-28, while other references place Theatre 10:30 in 1968-71. Most exact dates are not safely recoverable.

eras.label: CBC Theatre 10:30 chronology-disputed run
eras.notes: Series identity is secure but surviving references disagree on whether the relevant run belongs to 1961-era material or 1968-71.

historical_context.title: Klondike gold-rush historical setting
historical_context.description: The Rich Man Route adaptation draws on Pierre Berton Klondike material and the northern gold-rush route.

historical_context.title: CBC dramatic anthology tradition
historical_context.description: Theatre 10:30 belongs to CBC English-language dramatic anthology production and mixes Canadian original scripts with adaptations of established literature.

historical_context.title: Mid-century radio adaptation of classic horror and speculative literature
historical_context.description: The frozen set adapts works by Doyle, Jacobs, Bradbury, Berton, Crawford, Benson, Blackwood and Gilman alongside original scripts.

historical_context.title: Theatre 10:30 chronology dispute
historical_context.description: Surviving catalog evidence and later bibliographic references disagree on the run chronology; most exact broadcast dates are therefore unresolved.
